# The photon

Claims from wiphy.org; sits beside `Physlib.Electromagnetism.Basic`.

claims.name: photon_gaugeInvariance_transversality
claims.statement: A single photon state demonstrates gauge invariance, the no-(anti)ghost theorem, and the transversality of photon.

sources.title: BRST cohomology and Hodge decomposition theorem in Abelian gauge theory

claims.name: photonMass_nonlocal_regulator
claims.statement: A nonlocal, higher derivative correction to the photon kinetic term regulates the photon mass while preserving gauge invariance and Poincare covariance.

sources.title: Higher-Order Kinetic Term for Controlling Photon Mass in Off-Shell Electrodynamics
